headline: Dubai R3 complete: Tyrrell Hatton leads on 207 (-9) as Eugenio Chacarra (68) ties Rory McIlroy (72) at -5
whyCareReason: Tyrrell Hatton's third-round 68 earns a one-shot lead over Victor Perez (67), while Race leader Eugenio Chacarra's 68 pulls level with Rory McIlroy (72) at five under entering Sunday.
teaser: R3 FINAL (Earth Course): 1. Tyrrell Hatton -9 (207); 2. Victor Perez -8 (208); 3. Mikael Lindberg -6 (210); T4. Rory McIlroy -5 (211) & Eugenio Chacarra -5 (211). Sunday final round.
story: Tyrrell Hatton grabbed the solo 54-hole lead at the DP World Tour Championship on Saturday, 14 November, firing a four-under 68 to reach nine-under 207 at the Earth Course, Jumeirah Golf Estates in Dubai. France's Victor Perez carded a 67 to sit solo second on 208 (-8), one shot ahead of Sweden's Mikael Lindberg (69, 210). The headline duel for the season-long Race to Dubai crown converged in dramatic fashion: Race leader Eugenio Chacarra produced a four-under 68 to reach five-under 211, erasing a four-shot overnight deficit to tie Rory McIlroy. McIlroy, who held a share of the 36-hole lead, battled three consecutive bogeys around the turn before recovering for a level-par 72 to join Chacarra at 211 (-5, T4). Jon Rahm sits at three-under 213 after a third straight 71. Sunday's final round will decide both the $10 million tournament and the Harry Vardon Trophy.
stakes: Hatton takes a one-shot lead over Perez into Sunday while Chacarra's 68 puts him in projected position to clinch the Race to Dubai over McIlroy.
rivalryAngle: Chacarra and McIlroy stand deadlocked at five under with 18 holes left in the Race to Dubai after Chacarra erased a four-stroke margin on Saturday.
funFacts: Tyrrell Hatton leads on 207 (-9, 70-69-68) with Victor Perez one back on 208 (-8, 69-72-67).
Eugenio Chacarra shot 68 to tie Rory McIlroy (72) at five-under 211 in fourth place.
Sunday 15 November is the fourth and final round of the $10 million season finale in Dubai.
